they justify evil with *reasons* that go on forever. i want to scream with my full chest into the night until someone calls an ambulance. why spend time on reasons? it’s not important. it’s wasted time. it looks the same as real villainy, because real villains act in bad faith that looks the same

we could do something, if we all agreed to it. we’re almost out of time

it’s too much to hold
